messages:
Samir N: quick heads-up — ran a short pass of the fused_flash + paged-kv prototype on gpu-pool-3 (8xA100). seeing an unexpected p99 bump at 4k seq (~8%).
Maria L: ugh, thanks for flagging. can you paste the exact command and commit? :eyes:
Samir N: yup
```
/scripts/run_bench.sh --model llama-2-7b --seq 4096 --batch 8 \
  --kernel fused_flash_paged --kv-mode eager --commit=af3c9d2
```
Samir N: I also toggled --prefetch-kv=1 (no diff) and single-threaded io. baseline commit (main@c2b1f4) is ~8% lower p99.
Tay: can you drop the nvprof / nvtx trace? might be an interleave issue with the fused kernel + paged fallback.
Samir N: uploading a small flamegraph next, but quick grep in logs shows more kernel launches around logits loop.
Jules: @Samir N do you have the batch shape distribution for that run? if the majority are short sequences we might be triggering a different kernel path.
Samir N: attached simplified batch histogram: [8x 4096]. pretty uniform.
Maria L: ok if it's uniform then maybe the scheduler is splitting into smaller microbatches due to token queueing. what's the runtime config?
Samir N: runtime: continuous-batching=on, max_batch_tokens=65536, batch_timeout_ms=8. I'll repro with timeout=0 and burst off.
bench-bot: scheduled benchmark job 2175001300 (fused_flash_paged, seq=4096, batch=8, ci=false) — will post results here when done.
Tay: also try with --kv-mode lazy (paged-only read on demand). if the regression disappears that's a good clue.
Jules: pinging @Maria L and @Tay for quick code review on the kernel change I landed yesterday that touched launch concurrency. could be related.
Maria L: i'll take a look in the next 30m. if it's a quick revert we can hotfix tomorrow's canary.
Samir N: bench-bot finished early: job 2175001300 posted — preliminary numbers: p50 similar, p95 ~2% worse, p99 ~7.5% worse. nvtx trace uploaded to /mnt/bench/artifacts/2175001300/nvtx.tar.gz
Tay: grabbing nvtx now. if it's the launch rate we should see lots of small kernels back-to-back in the trace.
Samir N: thanks. if y'all think it's non-trivial I can queue a longer run (24h) with mixed batch shapes. otherwise prefer to try the timeout=0/kv=lazy experiments first. :+1:
Maria L: agree — start with the cheap toggles, then escalate. I'll comment on the PR with any red flags.
Jules: thanks team. keeping this thread for follow-ups so ops can correlate with the canary window later. :mag:
